purpose: Screen optimizer moment initialization and beta2 on the same own-random-lineage foundation endpoint; not a model release.

parent.receipt_binding: Resolve only after terminal full endpoint; require basename, SHA256, bytes, campaign spec SHA256 and ledger SHA256; never implicit latest.

arms.name: preserve-095
arms.optimizer_initialization: Restore parent AdamW moments and per-parameter step counters; preserve beta2=.95. Restart scheduler only.

arms.name: reset-095
arms.optimizer_initialization: Fresh zero AdamW moments and zero per-parameter step counters from identical parent weights.

arms.name: reset-scaled
arms.optimizer_initialization: Fresh zero AdamW moments and zero per-parameter step counters from identical parent weights.

common.weights: Exact same verified own foundation endpoint tensors in all arms
common.data_policy: Same next previously unused stream and order for every arm; do not cycle; do not touch sealed conversation acceptance data

scheduler.position: Arm-local committed targets at start of optimizer update

budgets.calendar_origin: First experiment launch before any arm initialization
budgets.replays: Charge attempted targets and active time again; never refund or expand caps
budgets.active_time_accounting: Model/optimizer initialization, evaluation and checkpointing inside Campaign count; read-only source/parent hash preflight is outside the active training timer and bounded by supervisor worker watchdog and experiment calendar deadline.

evaluation.validation: Original fixed 256 within-document windows, 512 targets each, FP32 mean CE
evaluation.context: Original32 counterfactual pairs; bothmembers must strictly prefer correct complete suffix by mean logprob; ties fail
evaluation.generation: Original32 prompts; greedy48token raw continuations; no repetition penalty, repair or host replacement
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired document-loss descriptive SE; correlated domains and repeated looks preclude formal independent-test significance claims
evaluation.baseline: Each arm verifies exact parent weights and retains baseline evaluation; source checkpoint remains protected

decision.primary: Compare each reset arm against preserved-moments control at matched committed targets; compare reset arms descriptively to isolate beta2.
decision.eligibility: All three arms must be terminal completed with exact19996672 committed targets and complete identical evaluation counts. Truncated or mismatched runs are inconclusive.
decision.sustained_screen_advantage: At each of10002432,15007744,19996672targets, paired mean CEgain over control must be>=.02nats AND strictly greater than2descriptivepairedSE.
decision.secondary: At all three latepoints candidate strictcontextpair count must not be lower thancontrol; endpoint repeated4gramflag count must not be higher thancontrol.

repeated_4gram_flag.scope: Generated continuation text only, excluding provided prefix
repeated_4gram_flag.flag: Any contiguous4-token tuple occurs at least3times
repeated_4gram_flag.meaning: Deterministic repetition heuristic, not human fluency or quality judgment

decision.selection: If any candidate qualifies, prefer lowest endpoint mean CE; exactties use fixed arm order reset-095 then reset-scaled. Otherwise retain preserve-095 as reference.
decision.inconclusive: Missing exact completed endpoints, weak/mixed gains, or diagnostic tradeoffs: preserve control and report no qualifying alternative; no automatic extension, sweep, SFT or promotion.
decision.release: Optimizer loss selection only; no base quality or conversational/tool capability pass. Allcurves and32rawoutputs retained; sealed confirmation remainsclosed.

safety.resource_policy: Inherit verified thermal/RSS/swap/disk/telemetry checks and STOP semantics; serious thermal>=2, repeatedRSS>18GiB, repeatedswapgrowth>1GiB or unreadable telemetry pauses safely
safety.retention: Each arm retains last2 full optimizer checkpoints INCLUDING endpoint; protect ONLY endpoint; initial baseline checkpoint remains rolling, source foundation parent protected; no protected intermediate/best checkpoints
safety.disk_forecast: Before first launch require free bytes >=20GiB + conservative all-remaining-arm last2 checkpoint bytes + one atomic temporary checkpoint + data/log allowance; use measured full parent checkpoint bytes with headroom. Recheck before each arm and save; if insufficient pause/report, never delete original protected artifacts.
safety.numerical: Stop nonfinite loss/gradient; same two-successive material regressions versus arm best beyond max(.20nats,5pairedSE) trigger deterministic confirmation then stop
safety.recovery: Immutable arm/experiment identity, full optimizer/RNG/cursor resume, bounded crash recovery; never override STOP or exhausted budget

freeze_requirements: Root approved protocol; pin runtime and verification identities before execution
Pin implementation and verification hashes before launch
Pin each immutable arm template and top-level experiment specification
Only unresolved parent terminal receipt is substituted by supervisor; checksum and bind resulting spec before first arm work
Assert corpus span supports source_offset+target_tokens with shifted input and distinct targets
Verify parameter/moment/step initialization, scheduler boundary and exact interrupted-resume in tiny CPU tests
Verify aggregate attempt/time accounting and disk forecast across sequential arms
interpretation_limits: One seed and one shared stream are a screening experiment, not multi-seed optimizer superiority
Preserved-moments arm includes common LR restart and is NOT uninterrupted scheduler continuation
Beta2 token-horizon mapping is a hypothesis, not a general hyperparameter transfer law
No new architecture, tokenizer, data mixture, SFT or pretrained weights enter these arms
